fusions.name: Buffalo Ford
fusions.desc: You charge up to 6 tiles to the target. It deals 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 6 tiles, and is left [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Herd Crossing
fusions.desc: Drives a wash of mud through a cone 3 tiles deep. It deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 2 seconds, and its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Evening Trough
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Millrace
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
